title: Checks for packages that are missing an __init__.py file.
summary: Python packages are directories that contain a file named __init__.py. The existence of this file indicates that the directory is a Python package, and so it can be imported the same way a module can be imported. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-no-pep420 and made it stable in v0.0.225.
message_templates: File `{}` is part of an implicit namespace package. Add an `__init__.py`.
File `{}` declares a package, but is nested under an implicit namespace package. Add an `__init__.py` to `{}`.

title: Checks for f-strings in gettext function calls.
summary: In the gettext API, the gettext function (often aliased to _) returns a translation of its input argument by looking it up in a translation catalog. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-gettext and made it stable in v0.0.260.
message_templates: f-string in plural argument is resolved before function call
f-string is resolved before function call; consider `_("string %s") % arg`

title: Checks for str.format calls in gettext function calls.
summary: In the gettext API, the gettext function (often aliased to _) returns a translation of its input argument by looking it up in a translation catalog. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-gettext and made it stable in v0.0.260.
message_templates: `format` method in plural argument is resolved before function call
`format` method argument is resolved before function call; consider `_("string %s") % arg`

title: Check indexing operations.
summary: Mypy checks that the indexed value in indexing operation such as x[y] supports indexing, and that the index expression has a valid type. mypy enables this error code by default.
